name: Mirage
description: The desert finale, an open map in the Elasto Mania way. You start in the middle, beside a small castle half buried in the sand, and the apples lie out on both sides: ride out to each end and back, in any order, and come home to the castle, where the flower floats at its door. West: down from the hub to a pit with a floor and an apple, ridden in and out from either side. Then a cradle, a floating bowl of rock over the canyon with a lip at each end, so it throws you across both ways; its apple waits in the bowl. Then the big west dune, with an apple high over its crest for a fast pass, and the cliff that closes the west, with an apple tucked in the cave under its overhang. East: dunes to hop going out and to roll coming back, with an apple over the middle one; a kicker each side of an open gap, with an apple high above it; a second cradle; and the big east dune, with an apple high over its crest. Past it lies the dead end under the eastern cliff, with the last apple. Up on the cliff top an oasis shimmers, palms over a pool, and nobody ever reaches it: a mirage. The gaps are open to the canyon floor far below: fall in and the run is over.
lesson: The desert finale: ride out from the castle to both sides and back, for apples spread over dunes, a pit, gaps and floating cradles, in any order.
alsoNew: Heat haze, cradles of rock over the canyon, and an oasis out of reach.
